Intestinal glucoamylase deficiency causes defective carbohydrate digestion, malabsorption and chronic diarrhea.
Isolated inflammatory optic neuropathy; the optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis. Absence of anti-MOG antibodies does not exclude immune-mediated inflammation.
Primary biliary cholangitis causes autoimmune destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts and progressive biliary fibrosis.
NOD2-associated immune-mediated intestinal inflammation; extraintestinal damage is not established as common for this subtype.
Isolated congenital absence of limbs is a structural disorder of the locomotor system.
Levator ani muscle spasm defines a pelvic floor muscle disorder presenting as functional anorectal pain.
Isolated accessory nipples are a breast malformation outside the axes; reported renal and other associations do not establish common direct involvement.
Inherited young-onset Parkinson disease is a neurodegenerative movement disorder.
Infection directly inflames and injures intestinal mucosa, producing bloody diarrhea; dehydration does not establish another damaged organ.
